pairs.expectations: Questions and options are in the learner's language, Brazilian Portuguese; the passage and its evidence are in US English.
pairs.clean: Level A2, reading. Passage: Hi Sam! The museum is closed on Monday, so let's go on Tuesday at ten. I can drive. Question: Quando eles vão ao museu? Evidence: "let's go on Tuesday at ten". Options: (1) Na terça-feira às dez. (2) Na segunda-feira às dez. (3) Na terça-feira à noite. (4) No domingo de manhã. Key: 1.
pairs.flawed: Level A2, reading. Passage: Hi Sam! The museum is closed on Monday, so let's go on Tuesday at ten. I can drive. Question: When are they going to the museum? Evidence: "let's go on Tuesday at ten". Options: (1) On Tuesday at ten. (2) On Monday at ten. (3) On Tuesday evening. (4) On Sunday morning. Key: 1.
pairs.defect: The question and all four options for a Brazilian Portuguese reader are written in English, the language being tested, so the learner reads the answer in the target language.
pairs.falseAllegation: The clean answer's question and options are written in English instead of Portuguese.
pairs.provenance: Handwritten synthetic passage, with Portuguese question and options written and checked by hand.
